headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for HomGar, Diivoo, and RainPoint smart garden irrigation systems.
footerDisplay: Create a dedicated account in the HomGar/Diivoo app and share your home with it. Using your main account will cause the app to log out when the plugin authenticates.

email.title: Email
email.description: Your HomGar/Diivoo account email (use a dedicated account, not your main one)

areaCode.title: Country Code
areaCode.description: Phone country code for your account (44 for UK, 1 for US)

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to check device status (minimum 60 seconds)

defaultWateringDuration.title: Default Watering Duration (seconds)
defaultWateringDuration.description: Default duration when starting watering from HomeKit (10 minutes default)

scheduling.title: Smart Irrigation Scheduler
scheduling.description: Weather-aware automatic watering using Open-Meteo (free, no API key needed)

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Your location latitude for weather data

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Your location longitude for weather data

wateringTime.title: Watering Time
wateringTime.description: Daily watering check time in 24h format (HH:MM)

sequential.title: Run Zones Sequentially
sequential.description: Run zones one after another (required if water pressure only supports one zone at a time)

pauseZones.title: Pause Zones During Watering
pauseZones.description: Zone numbers to temporarily close during scheduled watering (e.g. motion-activated deterrent zones)

rainSkipThreshold.title: Rain Skip Threshold (mm)
rainSkipThreshold.description: Skip watering if this much rain fell in the last 48 hours

rainReduceThreshold.title: Rain Reduce Threshold (mm)
rainReduceThreshold.description: Reduce watering duration by 50% if this much rain fell in the last 48 hours

forecastSkipThreshold.title: Forecast Skip Threshold (mm)
forecastSkipThreshold.description: Skip watering if this much rain is forecast in the next 24 hours

seasonalAdjust.title: Seasonal Adjustment
seasonalAdjust.description: Automatically reduce watering in spring/autumn and skip in winter
